metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over Chiang Mai, Thailand during March 2024 than Bangkok, Thailand?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS aerosol optical depth (AOD) product: "MODIS/006/MCD19A2_GRANULES" or "MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES" - Alternative: MODIS/006/MOD08_D3 (daily global) or Sentinel-5P for more recent data - Date: March 2024 (2024-03-01 to 2024-03-31) - Locations: Chiang Mai (~18.79°N, 98.98°E) and Bangkok (~13.75°N, 100.50°E) 2. Masking strategy: - AOD data typically has quality flags. Should use QA bands to filter invalid pixels. - The question is about AOD values, not clouds, so we need to mask poor quality data. 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: AOD can be 0 or very low (clean air), which is a valid measurement. - Null/Error (C3): If the result is None, NaN, or outside valid AOD range (typically 0-5). - Empty Collection (C1): No images in March 2024 for either location. - No Valid Pixels (C2): Images exist but after QA masking, no valid pixels remain. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define locations const chiangMai = ee.Geometry.Point([98.98, 18.79]); const bangkok = ee.Geometry.Point([100.50, 13.75]); // 2. Define time period const startDate = '2024-03-01'; const endDate = '2024-03-31'; // 3. Load MODIS AOD data (MCD19A2 - MAIAC product) let aodCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); // Check Chiang Mai const cmCollection = aodCollection.filterBounds(chiangMai); const cmSize = cmCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Chiang Mai images: ${cmSize}`); // Check Bangkok const bkkCollection = aodCollection.filterBounds(bangkok); const bkkSize = bkkCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Bangkok images: ${bkkSize}`); // If no data, try alternative MODIS product if (cmSize === 0 || bkkSize === 0) { console.log('Trying MOD08_D3 daily global product...'); aodCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD08_D3') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean'); const cmSize2 = aodCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Alternative product images: ${cmSize2}`); if (cmSize2 === 0) { console.log('No data available for March 2024'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Calculate mean AOD for both locations const cmMosaic = cmCollection.mean(); const bkkMosaic = bkkCollection.mean(); // Reduce region for Chiang Mai const cmStats = cmMosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: chiangMai.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const cmAOD = cmStats['Optical_Depth_047_mean'] || cmStats['AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean_mean']; const cmCount = cmStats['Optical_Depth_047_count'] || cmStats['AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean_count']; // Reduce region for Bangkok const bkkStats = bkkMosaic.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: bangkok.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const bkkAOD = bkkStats['Optical_Depth_047_mean'] || bkkStats['AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean_mean']; const bkkCount = bkkStats['Optical_Depth_047_count'] || bkkStats['AOD_550_Dark_Target_Deep_Blue_Combined_Mean_count']; console.log(`Chiang Mai: AOD=${cmAOD}, Pixels=${cmCount}`); console.log(`Bangkok: AOD=${bkkAOD}, Pixels=${bkkCount}`); // 5. Validation and answer if (cmCount === 0 || bkkCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (cmAOD === null || cmAOD === undefined || bkkAOD === null || bkkAOD === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - null results'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(cmAOD) || isNaN(bkkAOD) || cmAOD < 0 || cmAOD > 5 || bkkAOD < 0 || bkkAOD > 5) { console.log('Invalid AOD values detected'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare AOD values if (cmAOD > bkkAOD) { console.log('Chiang Mai AOD higher than Bangkok'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Chiang Mai AOD not higher than Bangkok'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
